description: This file contains Redux action creators related to the password reset functionality in a React/Redux application. It includes actions for changing form data, submitting password reset requests, handling success and error notifications, and dispatching navigation actions.

methods.name: resetPasswordChange
methods.description: Creates an action to update the reset password form data with a new value for a given field.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Asynchronous action creator that validates form data, sends a password reset request to the server, handles success notifications, and navigates to login page upon success.

methods.name: resetAccountPassword
methods.description: Asynchronous action creator that validates form data, sends a password reset request for account reset, handles success notifications, and signs out the user upon success.
